items.title: Chester Jones Interview, 1961-07-10
items.q: And Red Allen played bass drum that particular day... I remember singing, waste time of it, because I asked who the old man was and they told me who he was.

ctx.x: Yeah, they're out on the Southland now.
Yeah, that's right. They put them on there. But this guy named that, it is Allen or Allen, Allen, and that's his name?
